pdf.title: PDF Tools
pdf.description: All the PDF tools you need, running directly in your browser. Reduce file size before sending, combine scattered pages into one document, extract specific sections, or export pages as images — no sign-up, no uploads, nothing leaves your device.

compressor.name: PDF Compressor
compressor.desc: Reduce PDF file size while maintaining quality. Great for emailing documents or saving storage space.

merger.name: PDF Merger
merger.desc: Combine multiple PDF files into a single document in seconds. Simply drag, drop, and merge.

converter.name: PDF Converter
converter.desc: Convert PDF pages into high-quality images such as PNG or JPEG quickly and privately.

splitter.name: PDF Splitter
splitter.desc: Split a PDF into individual pages or extract a custom range of pages with ease.

guide.heading: What Are PDF Tools?
guide.intro: PDF files are portable document files designed to look the same across devices, operating systems, and apps. They are widely used for resumes, contracts, invoices, reports, and document sharing because formatting stays consistent. Common PDF problems include large file sizes, combining separate files, extracting only specific pages, and pulling images from pages.

image.title: Image Tools
image.description: A complete image editing toolkit that runs entirely in your browser. Resize for any platform, protect photos with watermarks, build collages, crop to exact dimensions, generate memes, convert between formats, or fix orientation — all in seconds, all private, nothing uploaded.

resizer.name: Image Resizer
resizer.desc: Resize images to any dimensions you need while preserving aspect ratio and quality.

watermarker.name: Image Watermarker
watermarker.desc: Protect your photos by adding text or image watermarks directly in your browser.

collage.name: Image Collage Maker
collage.desc: Combine multiple images into a beautiful collage with customizable layouts.

crop.name: Image Crop
crop.desc: Crop images to a precise selection or a fixed aspect ratio with an intuitive drag interface.

meme.name: Meme Generator
meme.desc: Create custom memes by adding captions to any image. Fast, fun, and entirely client-side.

converter.name: Image Converter
converter.desc: Convert images between JPG, PNG, WebP, and other formats instantly in your browser.

rotator.name: Image Rotator
rotator.desc: Rotate images 90° left or right, or flip them horizontally and vertically.

guide.heading: What Are Image Editing Tools?
guide.intro: Image editing tools help you prepare visuals for real-world publishing needs. They solve common problems around image formats, file sizes, social media requirements, and website optimization.
guide.seoNote: This kind of content ranks surprisingly well.

developer.title: Developer Tools
developer.description: Essential browser-based utilities for everyday development. Instantly format, beautify, and validate JSON with syntax highlighting, or test and debug regular expressions with live match highlighting and search & replace — no setup, no installs, just open and use.

jsonFormatter.name: JSON Formatter
jsonFormatter.desc: Format, beautify, and validate JSON data instantly. Supports syntax highlighting and error detection.

regexTester.name: Regex Tester
regexTester.desc: Test and debug regular expressions with live match highlighting and search & replace support.

guide.heading: Why Developer Utilities Matter
guide.intro: Developer utilities reduce friction during daily coding by helping with debugging, API testing, data validation, and overall productivity.
guide.seoNote: This is exactly the kind of content Google likes.

video.title: Video Tools
video.description: Capture your screen or transform video clips into lightweight animated GIFs — processed entirely in your browser. No extensions to install, no accounts to create, and nothing is ever uploaded to a server.

screenRecorder.name: Quick Screen Recorder
screenRecorder.desc: Record your screen or browser tab instantly without any extensions or software installs.

videoToGif.name: Video to GIF Converter
videoToGif.desc: Convert video clips to animated GIFs entirely in your browser. Fast, free, and private.

guide.heading: Why Video Formats Matter
guide.intro: Choosing the right format affects performance, quality, and delivery. Video workflows usually balance MP4 and GIF outputs based on file size, compatibility, and sharing needs.
